name: Enchantment Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Dissonant Whispers; Enthrall; Hold Person; Dominate Beast; Modify Memory. Enchantment spells you cast with a slot need no Verbal or Somatic components, and no Material component without a cost.

benefits.text: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Dissonant Whispers; Enthrall; Hold Person; Dominate Beast; Modify Memory.

benefits.name: School Benefit
benefits.summary: Enchantment spells you cast with a slot need no Verbal or Somatic components, and no Material component without a cost.
benefits.text: When you cast an Enchantment spell with a spell slot, it needs only its costly or consumed Material components: you can cast it while unable to speak or inside magical Silence.
